critical.issue: Frontend↔backend payload mismatch. Frontend (StadiumStudio.js line 270-272) sends {prompt, bpm, genre:'Hip-Hop'|'Trap'|'Lo-Fi'|'Boom Bap'|'Drill'|'R&B', duration_sec:30}. Backend BeatRequest (routes/studio_ai.py line 38-43) REQUIRES {genre, bpm, bars (default 8), key (default 'C'), user_id (REQUIRED)} where genre MUST be in ALLOWED_GENRES = ['mtv_classic','ministry_of_sound','hip_hop_top200','alt_rock']. Result: backend returns 422 with detail 'Field required: user_id'. Even if user_id were added, the genres from the dropdown ('Hip-Hop', 'Trap', 'Lo-Fi', etc.) would all be rejected with 400 'Genre must be one of mtv_classic|ministry_of_sound|hip_hop_top200|alt_rock'. AI Beat Maker will NEVER produce a beat in current state.

action_items: CRITICAL: Fix StadiumStudio.js generateBeat() (line 266-284) to send the correct payload shape to /api/studio/beat/generate. Required changes: (1) add user_id: userId.current to the POST body; (2) replace duration_sec with bars (default 8); (3) map dropdown genre labels to backend ALLOWED_GENRES keys — e.g. {'Hip-Hop':'hip_hop_top200','Trap':'hip_hop_top200','Lo-Fi':'hip_hop_top200','Boom Bap':'hip_hop_top200','Drill':'hip_hop_top200','R&B':'hip_hop_top200'} OR expand backend ALLOWED_GENRES to include these labels. Without this fix the AI Beat Maker is non-functional. Backend response key is 'beat.preview_url' (nested), not 'audio_url' or 'beat_url' — also adjust the response parsing on line 273.

Optional: When MediaRecorder isn't supported or mic is denied, surface a clearer message and ensure the rec pill only flashes briefly; the current behaviour is silent except for the toast. Consider adding a visual disabled state on personal-record-btn if MediaRecorder unsupported.
critical_code_review_comments: StadiumStudio.js line 270-272: hardcoded duration_sec instead of bars; missing user_id; genre values mismatch backend enum. This is the only integration bug blocking the feature.

StadiumStudio.js line 273: const url = res.data?.audio_url || res.data?.beat_url — backend returns {success:true, beat:{preview_url,...}} (data URL with synthesized WAV). Should read res.data?.beat?.preview_url.

BackstagePage.js line 152: when toggling tabs rapidly, the previous tab's recordings briefly remain in state until load() resolves. The watch button is correctly gated on tab==='kept' so it doesn't leak across tabs in practice.

StadiumStudio.js line 317-322: unmount cleanup hook has stems/lastTakeUrl in closure-captured stale snapshot (deps array is []). For correct cleanup of late-added stems, store them in a ref or include in deps with a current-mount guard.
BackstagePage.js line 30: userId fallback 'anon' will silently load no recordings if localStorage was never set — display a friendlier 'Sign in to see recordings' empty state.

rca of the issue: RCA: /api/studio/beat/generate has been schema-upgraded server-side to a Catalog Pivot model (genres = mtv_classic|ministry_of_sound|hip_hop_top200|alt_rock + per-user beat library requires user_id + bars-based sequencer rather than duration_sec). Frontend StadiumStudio.js generateBeat() was authored against the older shape {prompt, bpm, genre, duration_sec} and was never adapted. Reproduction: localStorage.pp_lane='creator', sidetrack_voter_id='rec_demo'; nav-record; type any prompt; click ai-beat-generate → 422 in Network tab + console error + toast 'Beat generator unavailable'. Mitigation: update payload as detailed in action_items[0].
